description: This file contains the implementation of the StreamSubscriptionManager class which manages subscriptions for streaming in Orleans, including adding, removing, and retrieving subscriptions.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionManager
classes.description: Manages stream subscriptions, allowing addition, removal, and retrieval of subscriptions in Orleans streaming.

methods.name: AddSubscription
methods.description: Adds a new subscription for a specific stream and grain reference.

methods.name: RemoveSubscription
methods.description: Removes an existing subscription based on stream provider, stream ID, and subscription ID.

methods.name: GetSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a given stream provider and stream ID.
